commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Sven Jablonski has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' 4 - 2 Donyell Malen (Dortmund) produces an outstanding solo effort and takes the responsibility to shoot. The ball goes low into the middle of the net and past the helpless goalkeeper.
90+7' The ball goes behind for a corner. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+6' A sweet pass inside the box gives Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
90+4' Edin Terzic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Wolf (Dortmund) replacing Marco Reus.
90+3' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
